title: Reading Drill — Testing map legends — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing map legends — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The cartography tutor in Elmbrook received an old report about readers mistaking building boundaries for paths. The report compared the number of navigation errors, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the marked copies rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include prior knowledge of the area. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a set of distinct line styles as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
